result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks in a dense urban environment. However, safety is compromised by a vehicle stopped within the crosswalk area and a lack of physical traffic calming measures on a multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: A blue SUV is stopped directly within the crosswalk markings, obstructing the pedestrian path and blocking sightlines.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and prevent vehicles from stopping in the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or stopping opportunities near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban commercial environment with wide brick sidewalks and signalized intersections. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes create significant exposure for pedestrians during crossings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the frame

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vehicles
hazards.description: Large vehicles parked or idling near the intersection can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Black car in the foreground right and bus in the background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban corridor with wide sidewalks and a marked crosswalk across a multi-lane one-way street. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the lack of physical buffers and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles increase risk in this high-volume environment.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Multi-lane One-way Traffic
hazards.description: Three lanes of traffic in a single direction can encourage higher speeds and create a 'multiple threat' scenario where one car stops for a pedestrian but another in the adjacent lane does not.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban pedestrian environment with wide sidewalks, high-visibility crosswalk markings, and signalized control. The presence of bollards provides a physical barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway, though the lack of dedicated cycling infrastructure forces cyclists into the travel lanes.

hazards.name: Lack of dedicated cycling infrastructure
hazards.description: A cyclist is visible riding in the travel lane, which increases the risk of conflict with motor vehicles in a high-traffic urban area.

hazards.name: Potential blind spot at archway
hazards.description: The large building archway may hide pedestrians or slow-moving vehicles emerging onto the sidewalk/roadway area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the building facade

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install a physically separated bike lane to reduce conflicts between cyclists and motor vehicles.
